adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U shows a sustained jump in N (~21 mm) and U (~-7 mm) around index 623, with E relatively stable. The offset persists through ~684–685, then returns sharply: N drops from ~17 mm back to ~-14 mm by index 690 (outside reviewed window but visible in context), and U rises from ~-7 mm to ~-4 mm. P1 starts too early (617) before the clear jump; P2 and P3 align better with onset at 623 and end near 685, but only one genuine platform is supported—interior points (624–684) are coherent and distinct from pre/post motion. Missing samples at 641–644 and 675/678 do not disrupt the platform signature. Independent permanent step at ~686 (nuisance_step_days) lies just after the return, confirming separation. Thus, only P3 (623–684) matches both boundaries and interior persistence.
